description: This file defines a class AWSTestConstants that provides constants and methods for testing AWS DynamoDB and SQS availability within the Orleans framework. It includes logic to check if DynamoDB is accessible by attempting to initialize a test table.

classes.name: AWSTestConstants
classes.description: A class containing static properties and methods to determine the availability of AWS DynamoDB and SQS services for testing purposes.

methods.name: _isDynamoDbAvailable
methods.description: A lazy-initialized boolean that attempts to initialize a DynamoDB table to check if DynamoDB is available.
